# Bring the work before it’s finished.

The SoCO Research Forum is a recurring multidisciplinary space for investigators to share work in progress, test ideas, refine methods, and develop collaborative projects across cutaneous oncology.

::: {.soco-section .soco-forum-intro}

## A forum for ideas in motion

Good research gets better through discussion.

The Research Forum creates space to bring forward projects **while there is still time to change them**—from an early clinical question or trial concept to preliminary analyses, methodological problems, and mature projects seeking broader multidisciplinary input.

Presentations are informal, constructive, and discussion-driven.

:::

::: {.soco-section .soco-forum-principles}

<div class="soco-card-grid">

::: {.soco-card}
### Share early

Bring a research question, study concept, trial design, or analysis before every decision has been made.
:::

::: {.soco-card}
### Invite criticism

Make assumptions visible, identify uncertainty, and use multidisciplinary discussion to strengthen the work.
:::

::: {.soco-card}
### Build together

Find collaborators, connect complementary expertise, and create opportunities for multicenter science.
:::

</div>

:::

::: {.soco-forum-callout}

::: {.soco-forum-callout-inner}

## From first question to final analysis.

Research Forum discussions may include **new study concepts, clinical trial designs, preliminary data, statistical or methodological questions, data-sharing opportunities, reproducibility challenges, and collaborative projects** across the spectrum of skin cancer research.
